purpose: śubham astu lekhakapāṭhakayoḥ (generic blessing for scribe and reader, no names)
notes: Final rubric of the text (end of daśamaprakaraṇa of Yogavāsiṣṭhasāra) followed by a stock blessing for writer and reader. No scribe, patron, king, date or place is named. "Vāśiṣtha" is the cataloguer's transcription for Vāsiṣṭha; it is part of the title, not a person.
